claim: In a phone browser with no sign-up, Trace Press makes a free 27-page 6x9 cursive practice workbook for adults (joined cursive on 0.45-inch lines, an A to Z and 0 to 9 chart page, page numbers) and its full-wrap KDP cover; the free book carries a footer line and a PREVIEW cover, and $19 once removes them.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It sets 6x9, 0.45-inch lines and cursive, ticks the alphabet chart and page numbers, types a title, downloads the interior (27 pages, read from the PDF) and the cover (the price dialog shows, then closes), and ends on pages 1, 2 and 8 and the cover, rendered from those files. The wait while the cursive book builds is real time. The final 2.2 s hold the cover still for the end card.
